visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of packaged burger buns and bread on a white kitchen countertop under bright indoor lighting. (2) A woman with short brown hair, wearing white printed pajamas, is seen from behind in a clean, modern kitchen with white cabinets and a wooden shelf containing a microwave and rice cooker; she reaches for a towel. (3) Handheld close-ups show the woman opening a refrigerator to retrieve a tray of eggs and placing them on a rack. (4) In the kitchen, she pours oil into a white frying pan and cracks eggs into a small metal bowl while wearing a beige apron over her pajamas. (5) A series of quick cuts follows the woman as she cracks multiple eggs, seasons them with a manual salt and pepper grinder that makes a clicking motion, and places sliced burger buns into a white VOTO brand air fryer/oven. (6) She retrieves a container of marinated meat from the fridge and fries the thin slices in the same pan alongside the eggs. (7) The final phase shows the assembly process: the woman spreads mayonnaise on the toasted buns, adds fried eggs, cheese slices, fried meat, and ketchup. (8) The video concludes with a close-up of four completed burgers on a pink cutting board and one burger placed inside a paper bag.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a gentle, upbeat acoustic guitar and piano BGM at approximately 105 BPM. A calm female voice narrators in Traditional Chinese. (2) A subtle plastic rustling sound occurs as packaging is handled. (3) The sound of a refrigerator door opening and a tray sliding is heard, followed by the percussive 'crack' of an egg against metal. (4) A soft liquid sizzle begins as oil meets the pan. (5) Continuous speech is layered over rhythmic mechanical clicks from a spice grinder and the metallic 'clink' of a bowl. (6) A digital 'beep' and the mechanical whirring of an air fryer dial are clearly audible. (7) The sizzling sound intensifies as meat is added to the pan. (8) Squeezing sounds from plastic condiment bottles (mayonnaise and ketchup) punctuate the narration. (9) The BGM continues steadily to the end as the narrator finishes her thoughts with a friendly tone.
